author: Huawei
description:
Cultural heritage is becoming more accessible through immersive technology. A student team from Türkiye built a VR experience that reconstructs the ancient site of Çayönü.
 
Built on #Huawei Cloud and Huawei LLM models, the solution uses AI to guide users through interactive, voice-driven learning experiences. It enables virtual access to fragile and hard-to-reach archaeological sites while expanding global access to a local 12,000-year-old site.
 
The Huawei #ICTCompetition 2025–2026 Global Final provides a platform for teams like Anatolianleopards to showcase solutions addressing global challenges. The competition enables university students and faculty to build ICT skills and foster innovation on an international stage. Learn more: https://bit.ly/4gb7ldJ #ICTheFuture
title: Students Reconstruct Türkiye's Ancient History With AI and VR
